title: CI first GitHub issue remediation
summary: CI-first remediation for open GitHub audit issues: bundled CI Python dependency install, CI media-tool provisioning, pysubs2 dependency coverage, Windows path-key canonicalization, and refreshed generated/WebView artifacts.
reason: Deep Audit release/package jobs were blocked by missing bundled runtime dependencies, missing media tools, generated context drift, WebView map drift, and Windows short-path/long-path comparisons.
behavior_before: Deep Audit release/package jobs copied bundled Python roots without installing project/runtime dependencies, did not provision release-expected media-tool paths in CI, lacked pysubs2 in dependency declarations, and could compare Windows path identities with inconsistent short/long forms.
behavior_after: Deep Audit release/package jobs provision dependencies into bundled Python roots, provision release-expected media-tool paths, include pysubs2 in dependency declarations, and watcher path identity uses canonical path keys for Windows-safe comparisons.
manual_validation: Generated-context checks passed: refresh_summaries --check, generate_project_index --check, generate_feature_file_map --check, generate_pipeline_map --check, generate_lifecycle_map --check, generate_config_schema --check, generate_stage_schema --check, generate_smoke_wrapper_map --check, generate_duplicate_test_name_report --check.
ops/scripts/release/Initialize-CiPythonRuntime.ps1 -PythonExe apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -InstallDependencies - passed for both bundled Python roots.

ops/scripts/release/test.ps1 -RequireTests - not fully green in the moving local worktree: first run failed a transient deferred-publish smoke that passed on direct rerun; second run passed end-to-end smoke but failed summary freshness after unrelated WebView/source edits appeared during the run.
rollback_plan: Revert Deep Audit workflow provisioning changes, remove Initialize-CiMediaTools.ps1, remove the InstallDependencies path from Initialize-CiPythonRuntime.ps1, remove pysubs2 dependency declarations, restore watcher path-key behavior, and regenerate affected docs/generated artifacts.
